name: gantt-project-app
description: GanttFlow - sistem manajemen proyek berbasis Gantt Chart

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gantt/server" "npm run dev -w @gantt/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @gantt/server && npm run build -w @gantt/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @gantt/server && npm run typecheck -w @gantt/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @gantt/shared && npm test -w @gantt/server && npm test -w @gantt/client
